Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Jones, Rich <rjones@gannett.com>
Sent: Friday, August 9, 2019 12:09 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: your old laptop 
 
OK, thanks.  Alright, well since you have all you data, let me see if I can get this sent back to Dell.  If the one you have is working fine, you might as well just keep that one and we’ll just reuse this one for someone else once it’s repaired.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, August 9, 2019 12:08 PM
To: Jones, Rich <rjones@gannett.com>
Subject: Re: your old laptop
Yep, my files came over. Thank you for the help.

Basically, the computer kept freezing to a manual restart point at the slightest of movements, especially from the bottom left side of the keyboard. That seemed to be a sensitive spot, where, let's say I picked up the laptop with my left hand from that area, it would immediately freeze. Many times, the screen went blank or muffled and if there was music playing, it would go into a continuous skip.

From: Jones, Rich <rjones@gannett.com>
Sent: Friday, August 9, 2019 10:05:23 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: your old laptop
Can you give me a couple sentences on what specifically it was doing?  Need to use that for the Dell warranty ticket, so far I haven’t been able to get it to mess up yet.
Also, you have all your files from this one, right?  Because when I send it back to Dell they’re going to wipe all the data off it most likely.
